subject: Outdoor Dining and Alcohol License Alterations
overview: The Commission met to review and approve several applications for the alteration of premises to allow for outdoor dining and alcohol service for the 2021 season. Most approvals were granted subject to final city administrative review of sidewalk and parking usage.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes for the March 17, 2020, license commission meeting.

items.title: Administrative Review of Pending Establishments
items.summary: Tabled applications for The Porch, Real Gusto, and Asian Taste due to lack of representation; the Commission also confirmed Bertucci's and Pizzeria Regina already hold valid permits for outdoor service.

items.title: Bistro 5 Alteration of Premises
items.summary: Approved the application for alteration of premises, featuring a plan to use flower planters along the sidewalk to separate the dining area.

items.title: FIORI Italy Alteration of Premises
items.summary: Approved the application for outdoor seating, which remains identical to the plan used in the previous year.

items.title: Carol's Restaurant Alteration of Premises
items.summary: Approved the alteration of premises for outdoor dining along the bridge, intended to begin on April 15.

items.title: Salvatore's Alteration of Premises
items.summary: Approved the outdoor dining plan for the rear of the establishment, pending the delivery of barriers from the city.

items.title: Tenoch Alteration of Premises
items.summary: Approved a first-time application for eight tables across two parking spaces, subject to final approval of the parking spots by the city.

items.title: C-Bar (Sabar) Alteration of Premises
items.summary: Approved the application for alteration of premises subject to the city approving the final outdoor dining layout.
